final_message:
Configured pc1 as the lab’s DNS server, with the requested host addresses and MX records for all four domains. All PCs and routers now use it for name resolution; the existing links, addresses, and routes remain unchanged.

The startup scripts passed shell syntax checks, and I verified the requested records and resolver settings in the configuration. I couldn’t run the lab or test live DNS queries here because Kathara and Docker access were unavailable. The configuration also assumes the `kathara/dns` image is available.
